hypothesis: Explicit positions and exact interval segments preserve learned events lost by a constant-period projection, but event timing quantization, interval accuracy, native tempo validation, meter and consumer policy may remain independent blockers.

inputs.scope: reuse only saved Beat This final0 events, frozen truth and coarse/projection outputs from the completed GTZAN development run

representations.control: unchanged OLS projection; reproduce all saved tuples and old score_window verdicts, including 187 joint-correct windows and all two coarse-to-OLS joint breaks
representations.explicit: every saved in-domain event at its exact integer source frame with original sequence index as ordinal; no insertion, deletion, smoothing, tempo-family choice or phase shift
representations.segments: exact lossless run-length compression of consecutive equal integer event intervals; non-final runs exclude their shared boundary beat, final run includes last beat; no approximation; do not truncate a graph larger than eight wire segments
representations.coverage: event-supported envelope [first event,last event+1), never the full audio source by assumption; keep declared PCM gaps separate; current recordings have continuous PCM and supply no known unavailable-input gaps
representations.tempo: selected convenience tempo is the unchanged whole-source consecutive-event OLS millibpm; each segment uses its exact own period and nearest millibpm; out-of-range segments reject rather than clamp
representations.meter: reuse the existing two-equal-complete-bars rule per original S6 window; bind each downbeat to its exact raw beat ordinal/coordinate; do not infer full-source single meter or fill unsupported windows
representations.native_checks: actual Rust payload writer/strict reader and external validator, native-result validator, same-grid downbeat lookup; distinguish payload roundtrip from complete-result acceptance
representations.consumer: inspect and exercise unchanged actual Pajoniiir subset converter with provisional graph and synthetic policy fixtures; no trusted result promotion or real product activation

diagnostics.frozen_score: old constant-grid score_window unchanged; it cannot directly score arbitrary explicit intervals
diagnostics.common_point_phase: every represented in-window point within 0.10 of the nearest reference beat's local period, using the unchanged nearest-five-interval local-period helper
diagnostics.common_point_period: each represented in-window point's outgoing successor interval versus that same local reference period within 1%; a constant segment retains its own period; explicit sequence uses its actual successor even outside the window; missing successor is unknown, not success
diagnostics.common_joint: complete original reference context, nonempty fully scored in-window points, all phase and period checks pass; report for OLS and explicit using these same definitions
diagnostics.sequence_coverage: separate strict diagnostic additionally requires one-to-one phase correspondence covering every annotated beat in the window; no precision-only success from omitted beats
diagnostics.projection_error: measure exact displacement and beat count changes from saved events to OLS; report fixed comparisons, never optimize against labels
diagnostics.quantization: report distance of saved points to the 960-source-frame/50-Hz lattice and the minimal single-interval error possible on that lattice versus local annotated periods; describe as a diagnostic constraint, not a new acceptance gate
diagnostics.regressions: report fixes/breaks for identical common diagnostics and keep original old-score regressions separately; never compare unlike metrics as a promotion gain
diagnostics.confidence: unknown/uncalibrated throughout; no safety acceptance from placeholder zero

gates.musical_no_regression_veto_for_any_later: zero old period/phase/joint breaks and independently verified transfer plus frozen product gates; this audit cannot promote a candidate
